sloka: एकएव हि वन्ध्यायाः शोको भवति मानवः ।अप्रजा अस्मि इति सम्तापो न हि अन्यः पुत्र विद्यते ॥२-२०-३७॥
transliteration: ekaeva hi vandhyāyāḥ śoko bhavati mānavaḥ ।aprajā asmi iti samtāpo na hi anyaḥ putra vidyate ॥2-20-37॥

translations.english: O my son a barren woman has only one mental agony that she has no progeny. Except that she does not have any other sorrow.
